editorial: In the software world, the security of open-source tools and corporate usage restrictions are at the forefront today. In particular, new benchmarks developed for coding agents embody technical advancements in the field of 3D modeling.

items.title: sherlock-project/sherlock
items.summary: Sherlock is a Python-based tool used to find accounts on different social media networks using usernames. It is accessible via community-prepared packages for various Linux distributions and package managers.

snapshot.description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks. Community-maintained packages are available for Debian (>= 13), Ubuntu (>= 22.10), Homebrew, Kali, and BlackArch. These packages are not directly supported or maintained by the Sherlock Project.

items.title: dsx-ai-factory/nvke
items.summary: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) is a management plane designed to manage GPU-supported Kubernetes clusters on physical servers. Developed in the Go language, this tool enables the configuration of hardware resources for artificial intelligence and similar processes by creating workload clusters.

snapshot.description: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE). A management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal. The local quickstart runs on a Linux host or VM, amd64 or arm64, with at least 6 CPUs, 12 GiB of free memory and 100 GiB of free disk. It requires Docker, virtual TPM support and the tools listed in the guide. Follow its setup through workload-cluster creation and confirm the cluster's nodes report Ready.

items.title: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
items.summary: OpenMausBot is an open-source Grok Bot alternative that allows you to build your own AI bot team within chat applications. The project aims to increase functionality by providing a virtual machine infrastructure that bots can use.

snapshot.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use. The open-source Grok Bot alternative: your own team of AI bots, in a chat app.

items.title: anthropics/claude-quickstarts
items.summary: The anthropics/claude-quickstarts offered by Anthropic contains projects that help developers create quickly deployable applications using the Claude API (a digital bridge that allows software to communicate with each other). Prepared in the Python language, this collection aims to simplify the AI-based application development process.

snapshot.description: A collection of projects designed to help developers quickly get started with building deployable applications using the Claude API

items.title: vercel-labs/agent-browser
items.summary: Developed by Vercel, agent-browser is a command-line interface (CLI) that allows AI agents to perform operations on a browser. Written in Rust, this tool reads pages as an accessibility tree, allowing agents to interact with web elements.

snapshot.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell.

items.title: meta/astryx
items.summary: Developed by Meta, astryx is a fully customizable open-source design system optimized for both humans and AI agents. Prepared in TypeScript, this project aims to support human and AI collaboration in modern software development processes.

snapshot.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready. An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them.

items.title: anthropics/skills
items.summary: Shared by Anthropic, skills is a Python repository containing various application examples that showcase the capability system of the AI model Claude. This resource offers ready-to-use skill packages that can be used in a wide range of areas, from creative projects to technical tasks and corporate workflows.

snapshot.description: Public repository for Agent Skills. This repository contains skills that demonstrate what's possible with Claude's skills system. These skills range from creative applications (art, music, design) to technical tasks (testing web apps, MCP server generation) to enterprise workflows (communications, branding, etc.).

items.title: google-deepmind/mujoco
items.summary: Developed by Google DeepMind, MuJoCo is a general-purpose physics engine that provides fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures in fields such as robotics, biomechanics, and machine learning. Written in C++, this tool aims to facilitate the development and research of systems that interact with complex environments.

snapshot.description: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator. MuJoCo stands for Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. It is a general purpose physics engine that aims to facilitate research and development in robotics, biomechanics, graphics and animation, machine learning, and other areas which demand fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environment.

items.title: ranxianglei/billion-context
items.summary: Developed with TypeScript, billion-context is a compression plugin that enables efficient use of the context window, which is the information capacity that AI can process at once. It reduces token consumption by 5 times in long monthly sessions, allowing work with smaller capacity windows such as 100k tokens.

snapshot.description: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions (billions of tokens) ,small context windows (a 100K context is enough) and token savings (5x fewer tokens) .上下文压缩插件，月级长会话会话， 兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token) . billion-context is all you need

items.title: Goodbye Claude, hello Pi
items.summary: The article shared by Caleb Software describes the user's transition process from using the AI model Claude to using the personal AI assistant Pi. With this change, the differences in the user's interaction preferences and personal experiences are highlighted.

items.title: Goldman Sachs is pulling Claude Code from its bankers and traders
items.summary: Goldman Sachs is restricting bankers and traders from using the coding tool Claude Code, transferring this authority back to engineering teams. The fact that the company made this decision shortly before the public offering of the AI model Claude, developed by Anthropic, is noteworthy.

snapshot.description: In July, Goldman's tech chief was praising the tools traders built with AI coding agents. New internal guidance hands those agents back to the engineers, weeks before Goldman takes Anthropic public.

items.title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" exposes passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
items.summary: The "Don't Ask Again" feature of the Claude Code tool causes the exposure of passwords and sensitive information in 1,122 public GitHub files. This situation highlights the security vulnerabilities of AI agents used in software development processes.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's letter to staff about affair
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang addressed allegations regarding his personal life in a letter sent to company employees. The letter discusses the impact of the situation on the company and the functioning of corporate processes.

items.title: Declarative Dragging
items.summary: Declarative Dragging offers a method that allows interface designers to define future model states to make an element draggable. This study, which won the best paper award at the UIST 2026 conference, addresses drag interactions with a declarative approach.

snapshot.description: Declarative dragging: an interface author makes an element draggable by specifying which future model states should be accessible by dragging it. Horowitz, Blinn & Heer, UIST 2026 Best Paper.

items.title: speridlabs/idol
items.summary: Speridlabs/idol is an AI tool that creates a 3D Gaussian splat model from a single photo. This system, which outputs a standard 3D file format (.ply), can run on consumer-grade graphics cards in under two seconds.

snapshot.description: image-to-3d model. Idol turns one picture of an object into a 3D Gaussian splat. Give it a render, a generated image or a photo: it removes the background, frames the object and generates up to 1,048,576 Gaussians, written as a standard 3DGS .ply. It runs on consumer GPUs, using 7.2 GB of VRAM and can run in under 2 seconds.

items.title: xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic
items.summary: xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic is an AI model with text-generation capabilities. Achieving high accuracy rates in GSM8K tests, the model aims to demonstrate performance similar to larger models with its 9B parameter structure.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. The NVFP4 checkpoint was evaluated on GSM8K four times, and the resulting scores were averaged. Its four-run mean accuracy is 94.50% under vLLM. In the comparison supplied with this release, the 9B student slightly exceeds the reported DeepSeek-V4-Pro teacher result and approaches the Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct reference.

items.title: moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro
items.summary: Kimi-K3.1-Pro, developed by Moonshot AI, is a multimodal and agent-based AI model capable of processing visual and text data. Trained on top of the Kimi K3 model using large-scale reinforcement learning methods, this open-weight model is presented as the first member of the K3.1 series.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight, natively multimodal agentic model, and our most capable 3T-class model to date. Post-trained from Kimi K3 with large-scale joint reinforcement learning across hundreds of downstream domains, it is the first model in the K3.1 series.

items.title: ricursiveAI/Ripple-65B-Preview
items.summary: Ripple-65B-Preview, developed by Ricursive Intelligence, is a dense Transformer model with 65 billion parameters trained on 12 trillion tokens. Supporting a context window of over one million tokens, the model demonstrates performance in agent-based coding tasks with the results it achieved on TerminalBench 2.1.

snapshot.description: Ricursive Intelligence introduces Ripple-65B Preview, a 65B parameter dense Transformer model pretrained on 12 trillion tokens with support for up to 1Mi (1,048,576 tokens) of context. Ripple-65B Preview delivers strong results on agentic coding, scoring 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1 and surpassing significantly-larger US open-weight models such as Reflection Beam 501B (80.1), Meta Muse Spark Open…

items.title: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
items.summary: Lightricks/LTX-2.5, shared on Hugging Face, is an image-to-video AI model that converts static images into moving videos. Allowing users to turn their visual content into dynamic videos, this model aims to simplify video creation processes.

snapshot.description: image-to-video model

items.title: Frontier3DBench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for 3D Creation across Objects, Scenes, and Interactive Open Worlds
items.summary: Frontier3DBench is an evaluation tool developed to measure the capabilities of coding agents in object and scene generation processes. Bringing different task scopes under one roof, this benchmarking system tests the performance of AI models that convert visual data and instructions into editable programs across 145 different tasks.

snapshot.description: Coding agents combine visual understanding with program execution, offering a new route to automated 3D creation. By translating images and instructions into editable programs, they bring reconstruction, generation, and editing into a shared workflow. Yet existing benchmarks fragment evaluation across task scopes and protocols, leaving their capabilities across construction levels unclear. We propose Frontier3DBench, a unified benchmark of 145 tasks across 9 categories spanning object, scene, an

items.title: OmniLatent: Unified Latent for 3D Part Modeling
items.summary: OmniLatent is a unified latent space modeling framework developed for 3D part decomposition operations. By encoding geometry, deformation, and appearance information in a common space, it aims to resolve issues such as geometric distortion and texture ambiguity encountered in editable asset creation processes.

snapshot.description: 3D part decomposition is a central capability for editable asset creation, yet existing workflows typically segment a completed mesh as a post-processing step, making the result sensitive to geometric artifacts, texture ambiguity, and limited part-level annotations. We present OmniLatent, a unified latent modeling framework for 3D part decomposition. Instead of predicting part labels in isolation, OmniLatent learns a shared latent space that jointly encodes geometry, deformation, appearance, and

items.title: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
items.summary: Video-Coder is a code-based AI agent developed to provide precise spatial structure and motion dynamics in video creation processes. The system provides structural signals for video production by autonomously writing and executing the code required to create dynamic 3D scenes.

snapshot.description: Recent years have witnessed remarkable progress in video generation in terms of visual quality and temporal consistency. However, generating videos with precise spatial structure, coherent motion dynamics, and controllable scene composition remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce Video-Coder, the first attempt to train a code-driven video generation agent, which autonomously writes and executes code to construct a dynamic 3D scene (Draft Video) that provides structure and motion signals

items.title: EvoWorld: Towards Out-of-Sight World Evolution in Generative Video Models
items.summary: EvoWorld aims for generative video models to go beyond visual consistency and logically infer changes in the world and the consequences of events. This study focuses on models not only generating realistic pixels but also reasoning and simulating the interactions of entities in the environment.

snapshot.description: Generative video models are increasingly used as visual world simulators, yet their primary strength lies in rendering plausible pixels rather than reasoning about how a world should evolve. Coherent world evolution requires more than visual fidelity: when an event occurs, a model must infer its consequences for the entities in the world and then render the resulting state. items.title: AgentBaton: Efficient Model Collaboration in Agentic Tasks
items.summary: AgentBaton, shared by Hugging Face, aims to optimize collaboration between models with different capabilities in complex and long-term AI tasks. This approach focuses on reducing costs while maintaining task performance by using high-cost models together with more accessible and efficient models.

snapshot.description: Solving long-horizon agentic tasks requires language agents to interact with their environments over multiple steps, and reliable performance often comes from the expensive capable models available through cloud providers. Meanwhile, alternative efficient models with inferior performance but a much lower cost are emerging, including lower-tier cloud models and smaller open-weights models deployable on local hardware. These are artificial intelligence software designed to automate software development processes, write code, or fix errors.
